parsed.answer: This matches earlier reports where clicking "New Key" in Mouse Without Borders does nothing and no devices appear. Those tickets were closed as duplicates of the open tracker issues #26995 (New key button not working) and #35807, so add your bug report ZIP and details there. Workarounds reported in #35904: (1) turn off "Always run as administrator" in PowerToys general settings, then fully close and restart PowerToys without admin rights. (2) Generate a new key on one machine, and repeat the process on your other devices. (3) Reconnect the devices, then restart PowerToys on all machines and restore admin mode if you want it. Also check that the PowerToys.MouseWithoutBorders processes are running in Task Manager. Another user in #35904 found that rolling back to the previous version, then updating again, fixed it. Your settings window problem that you fixed via #50335 may have left your configuration in a partial state, so a clean reinstall may also help.
